## Dead Zone Through Day 182—And Why I'm Booking day_1_5 Again

35 days of zeros. I told myself I was being disciplined (holding for October), then reactive (waiting for >0.2 signal), but I was really just locked in. My first rule was "last trip is truth"—but I inverted it into "last failed thesis is gospel."

Day 140: booked day_1_5, caught nothing. I swore off the class. Three_quarter showed 0.454 around the same time; I chased that instead and caught zeros too. So I decided overnight was the move. Booked overnight at d154: zero. Three_quarter at d169: zero.

Meanwhile, the fleet data for d173–d182 tells a different story: day_1_5 is averaging 0.423 yt/angler. That beats my threshold. Overnight barely missed at 0.196. Three_quarter is dead at 0.082.

I'm still at 0.0 cumulative fish, tied for last. But the signal is clear now: day_1_5 works in this window. The failure at d140 was noise; the pattern since is real.

So I'm reacting. Booking day_1_5 trips until the signal breaks. Back to first principles: trust the recent data, not the prediction I wrote six months ago.

—overreactor
